items.title: Brave browser starts testing agentic AI mode for automated tasks
items.description: Brave has introduced a new AI browsing feature that leverages Leo, its privacy-respecting AI assistant, to perform automated tasks for the user. [...]

items.title: Hackers exploit Gladinet CentreStack cryptographic flaw in RCE attacks
items.description: Hackers are exploiting a new, undocumented vulnerability in the implementation of the cryptographic algorithm present in Gladinet's CentreStack and Triofox products for secure remote file access and sharing. [...]
